fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'TestShipOpenPR|TestReviewJournaled|TestReviewDeclared' and go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/workflow pass, plus env -u'd of RHIZA_*/SHIP_*/REX_* go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-change$': a run whose workflow declares no review (myteam-flow from docs/examples/byo/workflow.toml, a review-less workflow in a Go test) opens the PR with no review journaled; the declared-review test is true for ship-change (conduct checks), ship-change-classic and review (a review workflow step or checks step) and bugfix; (failure case) a run whose workflow declares a review with none journaled still exits non-zero naming why, and a call outside a run is still refused
fields.files: internal/api/ship_openpr.go, internal/api/ship_openpr_test.go, internal/workflow/workflow.go, internal/workflow/workflow_test.go, docs/reference (only if rhiza docs regenerates a changed description)
fields.must_not: Decide by a workflow's or step's name; drop the guard for a workflow that declares a review; add a workflow file key; change docs/examples/byo/*.toml
fields.statement: rhiza ship open-pr requires a journaled review only when the run's workflow declares one (a checks step, a workflow step running a review, or an agent step with [[check]] tables), judged by the workflow's declared shape and never a name, so a workflow with no review such as the BYO example myteam-flow opens its PR after its own steps pass
